body: The full ROMA/RODE-style learned-embedding technique needs a dedicated embedding module + training machinery, genuinely bigger scope. Implemented the real minimal mechanism it depends on: sim_get_obs_team (apps/arena_training/src/headless.c) now appends a team_size-long agent-identity one-hot to each agent's own observation. Without this, the shared PPO policy has no signal for 'which of my team_size copies am I' and cannot mathematically differentiate behavior by slot even if that would score higher -- the exact hive-mind collapse NORTHSTAR §25.2 names as the problem. This lands the prerequisite a dedicated embedding module would consume, honestly short of the full technique (not claimed as complete role discovery). rl_env_team.py's team_obs_size() updated to match. Verified via --smoke-test: obs_size correctly grew 86->89 at team_size=3, tail of the printed observation shows the correct one-hot, and a real SB3 VecEnv rollout completes cleanly. The background 500k-timestep noisy-gestalt training run (started earlier this session) is unaffected -- it has the old .so already loaded in memory, unaffected by rebuilding the file on disk. Commits REDGARDEN 6d6e853, 95a3e6f.
title: NORTHSTAR §25.2.2 role discovery -- agent-identity conditioning prerequisite implemented
